company.name: Harborwick 3PL Ltd.
company.summary: Fictional 3PL/distribution warehouse: 6,000 m2, about 40 staff, two shifts, six zones A-F, electric MHE fleet.

facts.subject: warehouse_hall
facts.statement: The warehouse hall provides 6000 m2 of operational floor space.

facts.subject: warehouse_hall
facts.statement: The hall has 10 m clear height under the roof structure.

facts.subject: fenced_yard
facts.statement: The fenced yard outside the hall covers approximately 3500 m2.

facts.subject: building
facts.statement: The building provides eight dock doors.

facts.subject: dock_doors
facts.statement: The dock doors are at 1.2 m dock height.

facts.subject: main_transport_aisles
facts.statement: Main transport aisles are 4.0 m wide.

facts.subject: rack_storage_aisles
facts.statement: Rack storage aisles in the bulk-storage area are 3.0 m wide.

facts.subject: pedestrian_walkways
facts.statement: Pedestrian walkways are 1.2 m wide.

facts.subject: storage_handling_picking_packing_dispatch
facts.statement: All storage, handling, picking, packing and dispatch activities take place inside the single warehouse hall.

facts.subject: warehouse_hall
facts.statement: The hall is divided into six defined zones, A to F.

facts.subject: inbound_receiving
facts.statement: Doors 1-4 are designated inbound only and serve receiving.

facts.subject: outbound_dispatch
facts.statement: Doors 5-8 are designated outbound only and serve dispatch.

facts.subject: office_annex
facts.statement: The office annex is not used for storage of goods, handling equipment or packing materials.

facts.subject: drivers
facts.statement: Drivers must report to and remain in the marked waiting area until called to their door.

facts.subject: drivers
facts.statement: Drivers are not permitted to enter the hall.

facts.subject: dispatcher
facts.statement: The dispatcher assigns a specific door and time slot to every carrier.

facts.subject: vehicle_traffic
facts.statement: The speed limit is 10 km/h inside the building.

facts.subject: vehicle_traffic
facts.statement: The speed limit is 15 km/h in the yard.

facts.subject: vehicle_traffic
facts.statement: A limit of 5 km/h applies wherever people and trucks meet, including marked pedestrian zones, designated crossings and dock ramps.

facts.subject: zone_a
facts.statement: Zone A receiving area is 800 m2.

facts.subject: zone_a
facts.statement: Goods leave Zone A for Zone B, E or F only after document check, quantity count, condition inspection and system booking.

facts.subject: zone_b
facts.statement: Zone B bulk storage area is 2200 m2.

facts.subject: zone_b
facts.statement: Zone B high-bay racking provides 2400 pallet positions.

facts.subject: rack_bay
facts.statement: Each rack bay in Zone B carries at most 2700 kg.

facts.subject: zone_b_overflow
facts.statement: Overflow block-stacking in Zone B is limited to 3 pallets high.

facts.subject: zone_b_overflow
facts.statement: Overflow block-stacking in Zone B is limited to 4.0 m stacking height.

facts.subject: customer_order_picking
facts.statement: Customer order picking takes place only in Zone C.

facts.subject: picked_items
facts.statement: Picked items are scan-verified, packed and labelled before transfer to Zone D.

facts.subject: zone_c_replenishment
facts.statement: Pick faces in Zone C are replenished from Zone B before each picking shift.

facts.subject: zone_d
facts.statement: Zone D dispatch area is 900 m2.

facts.subject: outbound_staging
facts.statement: Staging of finished outbound loads takes place only in Zone D.

facts.subject: zone_e
facts.statement: Zone E chilled store is held between +2 C and +8 C.

facts.subject: zone_e
facts.statement: Zone E is subject to manual temperature verification each shift.

facts.subject: damaged_goods_quarantine
facts.statement: Quarantine for damaged goods is in Zone F.

facts.subject: damaged_goods
facts.statement: Damaged goods found anywhere on site are moved to quarantine in Zone F the same day.

facts.subject: value_added_packing
facts.statement: Value-added packing takes place in Zone F.

facts.subject: returns_inspection
facts.statement: Returns inspection takes place in Zone F.

facts.subject: hazardous_goods
facts.statement: All hazardous goods are stored only in the ventilated hazmat cage in Zone F.

facts.subject: hazmat_cage
facts.statement: The hazmat cage holds at most 4000 kg at any time.

facts.subject: loading_unloading
facts.statement: All loading and unloading takes place only at the eight designated dock doors.

facts.subject: dock_doors
facts.statement: Each of the eight dock doors is equipped with its own dock leveller.

facts.subject: inbound_doors
facts.statement: Doors 1-4 open into Zone A receiving.

facts.subject: outbound_doors
facts.statement: Doors 5-8 open from Zone D dispatch.

facts.subject: door_change
facts.statement: Drivers and warehouse staff must obtain dispatcher release to change doors.

facts.subject: inbound_unloading
facts.statement: Unloading at Doors 1-4 is carried out by inbound operators.

facts.subject: dock_apron
facts.value: only assigned vehicle and handling staff
facts.statement: During docking only the assigned vehicle and the staff handling that load may be present at the dock apron.

facts.subject: dock_operation
facts.value: store leveller, close door, clear apron before reassignment
facts.statement: After each dock operation the leveller is returned to stored position, the door is closed, and the apron is cleared before dispatcher reassignment.

facts.subject: shift_supervisor
facts.statement: The company employs 2 shift supervisors to cover the two-shift pattern.

facts.subject: morning_shift
facts.statement: The morning shift operates from 06:00 to 14:00 Monday to Friday.

facts.subject: afternoon_shift
facts.statement: The afternoon shift operates from 14:00 to 22:00 Monday to Friday.

facts.subject: floor_operations
facts.statement: During a running shift the designated shift supervisor directs all floor staff and controls movements between Zones A to F.

facts.subject: forklift_operation
facts.statement: Only the warehouse manager authorises who may operate forklifts.

facts.subject: overtime
facts.statement: Any overtime must be approved by the warehouse manager.

facts.subject: stocktake_results
facts.statement: Stocktake results are signed off by the warehouse manager.

facts.subject: write_off
facts.statement: Write-offs above 500 EUR require warehouse manager sign-off and wait for the manager.

facts.subject: outbound_release
facts.statement: Outbound release is owned by the dispatcher.

facts.subject: count_tasks_and_recounts
facts.statement: Count tasks and recounts are owned by stock controllers.

facts.subject: shift_supervisor
facts.statement: The shift supervisor remains on the warehouse floor or in the dock area during operating hours.

facts.subject: forklift_operators
facts.statement: The company employs 8 forklift operators.

facts.subject: counterbalance_forklifts
facts.statement: The site operates 6 counterbalance forklifts.

facts.subject: reach_trucks
facts.statement: The site operates 4 reach trucks.

facts.subject: electric_pallet_jacks
facts.statement: The site operates 8 electric pallet jacks.

facts.subject: hand_pallet_jacks
facts.statement: The site operates 12 hand pallet jacks.

facts.subject: inbound_operators
facts.statement: The company employs 6 inbound operators.

facts.subject: pickers
facts.statement: The company employs 10 pickers.

facts.subject: handheld_wms_scanners
facts.statement: Order picking uses 20 handheld WMS scanners.

facts.subject: stock_controllers
facts.statement: The company employs 2 stock controllers.

facts.subject: returns_packing_staff
facts.statement: The company employs 4 returns and packing staff.

facts.subject: returns
facts.statement: Every return must be inspected within a 14-day acceptance window.

facts.subject: dispatchers
facts.statement: The company employs 2 dispatchers.

facts.subject: maintenance_technician
facts.statement: The company employs a single maintenance technician.

facts.subject: floaters
facts.statement: The company employs 2 floaters for absence cover.

facts.subject: forklift_trucks
facts.statement: Every truck receives a documented check before its first use each day.

facts.subject: equipment_defects
facts.statement: Any truck defect is reported immediately to the shift supervisor and the maintenance technician.

facts.subject: cycle_counts
facts.statement: Stock controllers run the cycle-count programme daily.

facts.subject: stock_adjustments
facts.statement: No stock adjustment is posted without a second count.

facts.subject: truck_loading_sealing
facts.statement: No truck is loaded or sealed without dispatcher release.

facts.subject: pickers
facts.statement: Pickers do not pick from bulk storage or from quarantine.

facts.subject: floaters
facts.statement: Floaters do not operate forklifts or reach trucks unless separately authorised as forklift operators.

facts.subject: shift_supervisor
facts.statement: The shift supervisor approves damaged-goods write-offs up to and including 500 EUR.

facts.subject: returns_disposition
facts.statement: The final disposition of inspected returns as restock, rework or scrap is approved only by the shift supervisor on proposal from returns staff.

facts.subject: incident_report
facts.value: reviewed by shift supervisor before close of shift
facts.statement: The shift supervisor reviews every incident report before close of shift.

facts.subject: wall_to_wall_stocktake
facts.statement: The full wall-to-wall stocktake is held once a year.

facts.subject: stocktake_closeout
facts.value: manager signature before issue to clients and before posting adjustments
facts.statement: No stocktake result is issued to clients and no post-stocktake adjustment is posted until the warehouse manager signature is recorded.

facts.subject: write_off_threshold
facts.value: per incident or finding, splitting prohibited
facts.statement: The 500 EUR write-off threshold applies per incident or per damaged-goods finding, not per unit, and splitting a finding to stay below the threshold is prohibited.

facts.subject: overtime
facts.statement: Overtime is approved in advance by the warehouse manager before it is worked.

facts.subject: returns_restock
facts.value: inspection and supervisor approval before restock to Zone B, C or E
facts.statement: No return is restocked to Zone B, Zone C or Zone E without shift supervisor approval of the disposition after inspection in Zone F.

facts.subject: saturday_working
facts.value: Saturday morning in peak season only as overtime
facts.statement: Saturday working is overtime only in peak season and is limited to a Saturday morning shift.

facts.subject: weekend_night_operation
facts.value: no regular Saturday afternoon, Sunday or night operation
facts.statement: There is no regular Saturday afternoon, Sunday or night operation and no standing weekend roster.

facts.subject: absence_cover
facts.value: reallocation within shift and floater assignment before overtime escalation to manager
facts.statement: Absence is covered first by reallocation within the shift and assignment of floaters before escalation to the manager for overtime.

facts.subject: shift_start
facts.value: no shift starts without designated supervisor briefed and present
facts.statement: No shift starts without its designated supervisor briefed and present with command passed explicitly at changeover.

facts.subject: tagged_equipment
facts.statement: Tagged equipment remains out of use until logged repair and clearance by the maintenance technician.

facts.subject: shift_log
facts.statement: The incoming shift supervisor signs acknowledgement of the handover in the shift log.

facts.subject: hazmat_cage
facts.statement: The ventilated hazmat cage in Zone F covers 60 m2.

facts.subject: stretch_wrappers
facts.statement: The site operates 2 semi-automatic stretch wrappers.

facts.subject: cardboard_baler
facts.statement: The site operates a cardboard baler.

facts.subject: floor_staff
facts.value: high-visibility vests and class S3 safety footwear
facts.statement: Everyone on the warehouse floor must wear high-visibility vests and class S3 safety footwear with no exceptions.

facts.subject: forklift_operators
facts.statement: Seat belts on forklifts must be worn whenever the truck is moving.

facts.subject: shift_start_checks
facts.value: confirmations recorded before unloading, picking and loading
facts.statement: No inbound unloading at Doors 1-4, no picking in Zone C and no loading at Doors 5-8 starts until shift-start confirmations are recorded in the shift log.

facts.subject: zone_e_temperature_verification
facts.statement: Manual temperature verification in Zone E is performed by the supervisor or assigned operator.

facts.subject: dock_door_assignment
facts.statement: No door with a tagged-out leveller is assigned to carriers.

facts.subject: inbound_receiving
facts.statement: Inbound documents must be checked and passed before any unloading starts.

facts.subject: document_mismatch
facts.statement: If inbound documents are missing or incorrect, the inbound operator informs both the shift supervisor and the dispatcher.

facts.subject: receiving_plan
facts.statement: The dispatcher shares the receiving plan with the shift supervisor.

facts.subject: receiving_pallet
facts.statement: A pallet with load in receiving may weigh at most 1,000 kg.

facts.subject: failed_document_check_load
facts.statement: If inbound paperwork fails, the load stays on the trailer and nothing is removed.

facts.subject: inbound_receipt
facts.statement: On the same receipt, inspection follows count.

facts.subject: inbound_door_returns
facts.statement: Any return arriving at Doors 1-4 is transferred to Zone F for handling.

facts.subject: inbound_receipt_closeout
facts.value: close receipt in Zone A before door release
facts.statement: Each receipt is closed in Zone A before the inbound door is released.

facts.subject: system_pallet_labelling
facts.statement: Every booked pallet receives its system pallet label in Zone A before it moves.

facts.subject: inbound_booking
facts.statement: Booking on handheld WMS scanners is carried out by inbound operators.

facts.subject: shortage_overage_followup
facts.statement: Shortages and overages recorded at booking are flagged to the dispatcher for supplier follow-up.

facts.subject: wms_booking
facts.statement: Manual entry without scan verification is not permitted for WMS booking.

facts.subject: capacity_waiting_pallets
facts.statement: Booked pallets wait secured in Zone A if cold-store or hazmat cage capacity is unavailable.

facts.subject: put_away_to_zone_b
facts.statement: Put-away to Zone B is assigned to a forklift operator by the shift supervisor after booking and labelling are confirmed complete.

facts.subject: zone_b_overflow_block_stacking
facts.statement: Overflow block-stacking outside racking in Zone B is used only when directed by the shift supervisor.

facts.subject: put_away_placement
facts.statement: Manual placement to storage without scan confirmation is not permitted during put-away.

facts.subject: reach_trucks
facts.statement: Reach trucks used for high-bay put-away are rated at 1.6 t.

facts.subject: counterbalance_forklifts
facts.statement: Counterbalance forklifts used for high-bay put-away are rated at 2.5 t.

facts.subject: put_away_location_mismatch
facts.statement: Any mismatch between system location and physical location during placement is held and reported to the stock controllers.

facts.subject: chilled_hazmat_quarantine_returns_stock
facts.value: not Zone B, only Zone E or Zone F
facts.statement: Chilled, hazmat, quarantine and returns stock are never put away to Zone B and are routed only to Zone E or Zone F.

facts.subject: put_away_to_zone_b
facts.statement: Put-away must be confirmed by scan before the pallet becomes available reserve for replenishment.

facts.subject: zone_e
facts.statement: Zone E chilled store covers 300 m2.

facts.subject: chilled_stock
facts.statement: No chilled stock is stored elsewhere in the hall outside Zone E.

facts.subject: zone_e
facts.statement: Zone E stores only chilled product with no ambient, hazmat, quarantine or returns stock.

facts.subject: zone_e_doors
facts.value: put-away, replenishment to Zone C, count or inspection only
facts.statement: Zone E doors are opened only for put-away, replenishment to Zone C, count or inspection.

facts.subject: zone_e_temperature_deviation
facts.statement: On Zone E alarm, out-of-range reading or door failure the shift supervisor takes charge.

facts.subject: zone_e_temperature_deviation
facts.statement: The warehouse manager is notified without delay on Zone E alarm or deviation.

facts.subject: chilled_pick_face_replenishment
facts.statement: Replenishment of chilled pick faces and picking of chilled orders are drawn only from verified Zone E stock.

facts.subject: zone_f
facts.statement: Zone F services and control covers 600 m2.

facts.subject: hazmat_cage
facts.statement: The hazmat cage holds hazardous goods only and nothing else.

facts.subject: hazmat_cage_access
facts.statement: Access to the hazmat cage is limited to trained staff assigned by the shift supervisor.

facts.subject: hazmat_receipt_release
facts.value: supervisor confirms capacity before release from Zone A
facts.statement: The shift supervisor confirms remaining cage capacity by weight and pallet positions before any booked hazmat receipt is released from Zone A.

facts.subject: hazmat_cage
facts.statement: The hazmat cage is checked visually each shift.

facts.subject: spill_response
facts.statement: The shift supervisor takes charge on hazmat leakage, odour, damaged container or spill alarm.

facts.subject: spill_event
facts.statement: The warehouse manager is notified without delay on hazmat spill or leakage.

facts.subject: hazmat_cage
facts.statement: Smoking, charging and hot work are prohibited at the hazmat cage.

facts.subject: quarantine_label
facts.value: date, origin zone, receipt or order reference, reason and finder initials
facts.statement: Quarantine labels must show date, origin zone, receipt or order reference, reason and finder initials.

facts.subject: open_quarantine_cage_holds
facts.statement: Open quarantine holds, cage over-limit risks and uncleared spills roll forward at 14:00 and 22:00 until cleared.

facts.subject: zone_c
facts.statement: Zone C picking area covers 1200 m2.

facts.subject: zone_c_replenishment
facts.statement: Ambient replenishment to Zone C pick faces comes only from confirmed reserve in Zone B, never direct from Zone A, Zone D or Zone F quarantine.

facts.subject: picking_shift_start
facts.statement: Picking on a shift does not start until the shift supervisor confirms replenishment for that shift is complete or formally carried as shortage.

facts.subject: replenishment_withdrawal
facts.statement: Reserve pallets are confirmed by scan of location and pallet ID before the pallet is broken down or moved for replenishment.

facts.subject: unfilled_pick_faces
facts.statement: Unfilled pick faces and outstanding reserve moves roll forward at 14:00 and 22:00.

facts.subject: picking_tasks
facts.statement: Picking tasks are assigned by the shift supervisor by zone and priority.

facts.subject: order_picking
facts.value: scanner tasks only; verbal, paper and memory prohibited
facts.statement: Order picking is performed only on scanner-issued tasks and verbal instruction, paper lists and picking to memory are prohibited.

facts.subject: pick_verification
facts.statement: Pick verification follows scan of pick-face location label then scan of each item or carton then batch/expiry confirmation and quantity entry.

facts.subject: picking_exception
facts.statement: On empty, short, damaged, mislabelled or mixed batch/expiry face the picker informs the supervisor and stock controllers.

facts.subject: consolidated_pick_pallet
facts.statement: A pallet with load consolidated from picks may weigh at most 1,000 kg.

facts.subject: zone_d_staging
facts.statement: Zone D holds only wrapped, labelled pallets by door and load.

facts.subject: palletised_load_wrapping
facts.statement: Palletised loads are wrapped at Zone D entry on the semi-automatic stretch wrappers.

facts.subject: cardboard_packing_waste
facts.statement: Cardboard offcuts, backing and damaged cartons from packing go directly to the cardboard baler.

facts.subject: packing_mismatch
facts.statement: Packing mismatches, short quantities, damaged cartons or mislabelled faces are reported to the shift supervisor.

facts.subject: packing_label_check
facts.statement: The packer scans the packed label against the order task to confirm match before release.

facts.subject: completed_packed_pallets
facts.statement: Completed wrapped and labelled pallets roll forward at 14:00 and 22:00 for staging and loading.

facts.subject: outbound_loading
facts.statement: Loading in Zone D is carried out by forklift operators under supervisor direction.

facts.subject: outbound_load
facts.statement: Outbound loads are built in reverse loading order so the first drop is loaded last.

facts.subject: loaded_vehicle
facts.statement: Every loaded vehicle is count-checked and release-matched before doors are closed and seal applied and recorded by number.

facts.subject: trailer
facts.statement: Each contracted curtain-side trailer carries at most 24,000 kg.

facts.subject: trailer
facts.statement: Each trailer provides 33 floor positions.

facts.subject: trailer
facts.statement: A trailer takes at most 24 full-weight 1,000 kg pallets because weight governs before floor space.

facts.subject: delivery_van
facts.statement: Each delivery van carries at most 1,200 kg.

facts.subject: delivery_van
facts.statement: Each delivery van provides 6 floor positions.

facts.subject: delivery_van
facts.statement: A van takes only one full-weight 1,000 kg pallet.

facts.subject: outbound_door
facts.statement: Each outbound door handles at most 3 trailer loads per shift.

facts.subject: outbound_throughput
facts.statement: The most that can be promised to clients is 288 full-weight pallets per shift from 4 doors times 3 loads times 24 pallets.

facts.subject: delivery_van
facts.value: consignments over 1200 kg or over one full-weight pallet go by trailer, no split across vans
facts.statement: Any consignment heavier than 1,200 kg or requiring more than one full-weight pallet goes by trailer and is not split across vans.

facts.subject: uncompleted_outbound_loads
facts.statement: Uncompleted outbound loads roll forward at 14:00 and 22:00.

facts.subject: uncompleted_outbound_loads
facts.statement: Uncompleted loads rolled forward remain counted against the next shift's 288-pallet capacity when loaded.

facts.subject: materials_handling_fleet
facts.value: all-electric, no diesel or gas trucks in hall
facts.statement: The materials-handling fleet is all-electric with no diesel or gas trucks used in the hall.

facts.subject: shift_supervisor
facts.statement: The shift supervisor allocates the pooled materials-handling fleet daily.

facts.subject: counterbalance_forklifts
facts.value: not used for high-bay placement above reach-truck levels in Zone B
facts.statement: Counterbalance forklifts are not used for high-bay placement above the reach-truck levels in Zone B.

facts.subject: truck_charging
facts.value: designated charging points clear of walkways, dock aprons and hazmat cage
facts.statement: Trucks are charged only in designated charging points clear of walkways, dock aprons and the hazmat cage.

facts.subject: fleet_defects_and_missing_trucks
facts.statement: Open truck defects and missing trucks roll forward at 14:00 and 22:00 until cleared.

facts.subject: rack_aisle_bay
facts.statement: Only one truck works a rack aisle bay at a time.

facts.subject: pedestrian_walkway
facts.statement: Pedestrian walkways are physically separated from vehicle aisles by yellow barriers.

facts.subject: reversing_at_live_apron
facts.statement: Reversing at a live door apron is directed by a banksman clear of barriers.

facts.subject: aisle_walkway_speed_markings
facts.statement: Aisles, walkways and speed markings are checked each shift.

facts.subject: blocked_aisle_barrier_marking
facts.statement: Blocked aisles, damaged barriers or faded markings are cleared before doors are released.

facts.subject: aisle_speeding_barrier_breach
facts.statement: Speeding, barrier damage, blocked aisles or walkways, and apron incursions are carried forward at 14:00 and 22:00 until cleared.

facts.subject: stretch_wrappers
facts.statement: The 2 semi-automatic stretch wrappers are run by dispatch and packing staff.

facts.subject: dock_packing_equipment
facts.statement: Upkeep of dock levellers, stretch wrappers and the cardboard baler is owned by the maintenance technician.

facts.subject: unwrapped_pallet
facts.statement: No unwrapped pallet is loaded.

facts.subject: cardboard_baler
facts.statement: Plastic film, strapping, labels and general waste are never fed to the cardboard baler.

facts.subject: dock_packing_equipment_status
facts.statement: Open dock and packing equipment statuses roll forward at 14:00 and 22:00 until cleared.

facts.subject: powered_truck_task_allocation
facts.statement: The supervisor confirms operators against the authorised list before allocating powered-truck tasks.

facts.subject: pickers_inbound_operators
facts.statement: Pickers and inbound operators must not drive powered trucks unless separately authorised as forklift operators.

facts.subject: forklift_startup
facts.statement: Forklift operators must fasten the seat belt before turning the key.

facts.subject: afternoon_shift
facts.statement: The afternoon shift re-confirms powered-truck status at 14:00.

facts.subject: warehouse_manager
facts.statement: New forklift operators are authorised personally and in writing by the warehouse manager.

facts.subject: pedestrian_walkways
facts.statement: Pedestrian walkways are for people only and are never used for truck travel, pallet staging, charging cables, or waste.

facts.subject: pedestrian_crossing
facts.statement: Pedestrians cross vehicle aisles only at designated crossings.

facts.subject: walkway_obstruction
facts.statement: Any pallet, jack or obstruction found on a walkway is reported to the shift supervisor.

facts.subject: barrier_marking_defect
facts.statement: Blocked walkways, damaged barriers and faded markings are reported to the maintenance technician.

facts.subject: vest_footwear_checks
facts.statement: Vests and footwear are checked at shift start by the shift supervisor.

facts.subject: ppe_enforcement
facts.statement: PPE enforcement belongs to the shift supervisor on duty.

facts.subject: ppe_replacements_breaches
facts.statement: Open PPE replacements and unresolved breaches roll forward at 14:00 and 22:00 until cleared.

facts.subject: cycle_count
facts.statement: Cycle counts require scanning the location label then each pallet ID before confirming item, quantity, batch and expiry.

facts.subject: recount
facts.statement: Every difference recount is carried out by a different counter from the first count.

facts.subject: third_count_check
facts.statement: A third check when first, second and book figures all differ is directed by stock controllers with the shift supervisor present.

facts.subject: recounts_and_blocked_locations
facts.statement: Recounts and blocked locations roll forward at 14:00 and 22:00 until cleared.

facts.subject: first_count
facts.statement: The first cycle count is blind and the counter does not see the system quantity before entering the result.

facts.subject: shift_supervisor
facts.statement: The shift supervisor does not change the count list or cancel a count once issued.

facts.subject: stocktake_date
facts.statement: The warehouse manager sets the date of the annual stocktake.

facts.subject: stocktake_count_window
facts.value: no receiving, put-away, replenishment, picking, packing or loading
facts.statement: No receiving at Doors 1-4, put-away to Zone B, replenishment to Zone C, picking, packing or loading from Zone D takes place during the stocktake count window.

facts.subject: stocktake_counters
facts.statement: Stocktake counters work in pairs by aisle and bay.

facts.subject: hazmat_cage_stocktake
facts.statement: The hazmat cage is counted by assigned trained staff without opening containers.

facts.subject: quarantine_stock
facts.statement: Quarantine goods are counted but never used to clear a stocktake difference.

facts.subject: stocktake_restart
facts.statement: Normal operations restart only after the warehouse manager stocktake sign-off is recorded.

facts.subject: racking_safety_inspection
facts.statement: The high-bay pallet racking in Zone B receives a documented safety inspection every month.

facts.subject: stock_adjustment
facts.statement: Stock adjustments are prepared by the stock controllers after investigation.

facts.subject: difference_recount
facts.value: location, adjacent beams and pick face
facts.statement: Every difference recount covers the location, adjacent beams and pick face for misplacement.

facts.subject: racking_repair
facts.statement: Racking repair is owned by the maintenance technician.

facts.subject: rack_damage
facts.statement: Rack damage is reported by the finder to the shift supervisor and the maintenance technician.

facts.subject: returns_rework
facts.statement: Rework of approved returns is carried out only in Zone F.

facts.subject: returns_inspection
facts.statement: Every returned unit is inspected individually without sampling.

facts.subject: returns_exception
facts.statement: Returns outside the window, without traceable reference, or unannounced hazmat or chilled goods without paperwork are escalated to the shift supervisor and dispatcher.

facts.subject: open_returns_holds
facts.statement: Open inspections, rework in progress and blocked quarantine holds roll forward at 14:00 and 22:00 until disposition and posting are complete.

facts.subject: damaged_goods_quarantine
facts.value: separate from packing, returns inspection and hazmat cage in Zone F
facts.statement: Damaged-goods quarantine in Zone F is physically separate from value-added packing, returns inspection and the hazmat cage.

facts.subject: damaged_hazmat
facts.value: segregated from general quarantine to PR-13 hazmat instruction
facts.statement: Damaged hazmat is segregated per PR-13 and never placed with general quarantine unless the cage procedure directs it.

facts.subject: damaged_goods_inspection
facts.statement: Inspection of segregated damaged goods is performed by returns and packing staff.

facts.subject: damaged_goods_disposition
facts.statement: Final restock, rework or scrap disposition of damaged goods is decided only by the shift supervisor.

facts.subject: damaged_goods_handling
facts.statement: Damaged goods are secured, transferred to quarantine, labelled and blocked, then inspected, then proposed for disposition, then released only on recorded supervisor decision.

facts.subject: value_added_rework_packing
facts.value: Zone A, Zone B, Zone C, Zone D
facts.statement: No value-added or rework packing takes place in Zone A, Zone B, Zone C or Zone D.

facts.subject: reworked_value_added_unit
facts.value: item, quantity, batch and expiry, pallet ID where palletised, order reference where applicable
